digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend assembly and contract conformance
propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend does not implement two required Backend protocol members (query_project and assert_env_ready), causing isinstance() checks to fail and leaving the backend unreachable despite registration
The reconciler.backend config validator rejects 'jira-datacenter' as a valid choice, preventing DC deployments from being configured even though the backend is registered
DC inbound assignee identities fail to mint because the identity path requires accountId (which DC lacks), while the ticket-creation path hard-codes 'jira' channel, creating inconsistency
The TicketTransport protocol omits set_entity_property despite the core calling it from three sites, making protocol conformance insufficient to prove correctness
Inbound identity minting under DC currently maps to 'jira-datacenter' channel which is not in CREATION_CHANNELS vocabulary, causing validation failures when the flow reaches it
The contract suite never exercised the DC backend against its port assertions, allowing latent conformance defects to pass unit testing undetected
